user.title: Add Virtual Switch
user.description: A switch for a thermostat: its actions run as Home Assistant scripts (sequences, conditions, delays). Heating or cooling comes from the thermostats that control it. Its state is read from the power sensor.

data.name: Name
data.min_power: Minimum power (W) to treat device as on

data_description.heating_action: Runs on "on" when the thermostats of this switch heat (or without a thermostat)

data_description.off_action: Action to run when switch is turned off
data_description.min_power: At or above this power the switch is on
data_description.power_hysteresis_percent: On goes to off only below the minimum power minus this share of it
data_description.power_delay_seconds: A change of the state (and no power data) is shown only after it has lasted this long
